body: Live workaround (Termal::Fable2, 2026-10-12 04:09Z), holding until the w-8678684da0c4 fix is running on the host. When a Merger full gate PASSES all stages but the host refuses credit for a change under the gate's own .tmp/ (the w-8678 defect, e.g. termal.sqlite-journal or -wal under termal-test-state-*), what happens depends on the item's criteria. If none is test-bound: no re-gate. The commit proceeds on the launcher PASS once the Merger verifies the run's own input-fingerprint check matched the frozen tree (results.json, input.json), citing the verbatim refusal and w-8678 in the commit note; the evaluator judges from that. If a criterion IS test-bound (the evaluation needs a host-recorded check): ONE documented re-gate is allowed, never a loop. Engram::Fable follows the same "no credit-only reruns" practice. Occurrences: w-6c1d test-58e416fa (journal) and w-fe9f test-aa5b0d13 (wal).
